integrity: Reproducibility sources, reference output and explicit graph isomorphism included; no statistical extrapolation or unproved infinite extension.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite statement for a single labelled graph; exhaustive algorithms are self-contained but independent scholarly validation and exhaustive historical priority checking have not been performed. The four-colour minimum itself is not new.
title: Frozen colourings and a sharp two-vertex mobility threshold for the Heawood incidence graph
